provenance.independenceBoundary: Reviewed original dev input without historical model outputs, other audits or formal-v3 revision rationale. Earlier formal review and p21 contract feedback are disclosed; not an entirely context-blind reviewer.

method.transaction: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout=8s; SELECT ...; ROLLBACK
method.selection: All 100 original dev IDs reviewed; no model-score selection and no paid calls.

decisionDefinitions.KEEP: No concrete issue sufficient to reject this reference was found within the current contract and bounded review. Does not prove all hypothetical future data states.
decisionDefinitions.REFERENCE_DEFECT: A concrete logical/output/coverage error is demonstrated, rather than merely preferring another reasonable default.
decisionDefinitions.CONTRACT_CONFLICT: Reference implements a different projection, ranking, period or window convention than the current explicit product default.
decisionDefinitions.AMBIGUOUS: Important population, attribution, unit or identity choice is not uniquely resolved; proposedQuestion is a suggestion, not business approval.
decisionDefinitions.COINCIDENTAL_EQUIVALENCE: Current data hide a specific missing constraint, NULL population or empty-input error; actual schema/CTE evidence prevents generalizing snapshot equivalence.

crossCuttingFindings: Do not interpret 56 KEEP as model accuracy. These are reference-governance classifications and no model was run.

Prompt LIMIT and stable display order are not used to indiscriminately reject all full-group Gold. Actual TopN cutoff ties and semantic loss are examined separately; candidate LIMIT ALL is PostgreSQL-executable but runtime validator support is not audited here.
No blanket valid-order filter is added to ordinary counts or explicit all-record questions. Registered metrics retain their documented filters, units and zero-denominator behavior.
Missing month is not automatically zero. p21 requires explicit zero instruction or coverage evidence; observed MIN/MAX is insufficient. T3-011 candidate leaves missing count NULL.
Date-domain >D-30 equals >=D-29 for members.last_login_date, so T3-028 is retained. Timestamp-domain >A-90 days differs from natural days, so T3-013 conflicts.
Display names are not primary keys. Default ID, complete entity identity, and internal-only ranking keys are distinguished; name collisions and NULL properties are not assumed impossible.
Grouped nonempty COUNT denominators cannot be zero; missing NULLIF is only flagged when an actual empty aggregate can produce a zero denominator.

Causal activity attribution, physical city identity, actual-refund categories, spend population, price-change units/weights and repeat-rate denominator require explicit questions; no suggested wording is treated as human confirmation.

Raw SQL catalogues reviewer-checks.sql and reviewer-candidates.sql are executed CASE by CASE inside read-only 8-second transactions. Exact bodies, synthetic markers and exit statuses are retained in result JSON.
